phenotype_specificity.statement: Review-table flags only: ID/DD, drug-resistant early-onset seizures and dystonia in all four, with improvement in seizure control and muscle tone on creatine. No biochemical, MRS or MRI data and no information on testing of other genes are given (MRI/MRS 'NR').

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: 1-bp deletion causing a frameshift, predicted p.(His108GlnfsTer6) (from the HGVS); the review labels it 'Deletion, frameshift'. No variant-specific mechanism statement.

concerns: Variant appears only in review tables (42885896 Tables 1-3 and S2) without a case description; primary reports (Modi 2021, Engelke 2009) are not in this batch and were not read.
The four persons are siblings (Table 1 footnote), so this is a single family.
Zygosity is not stated; the table lists only c.324delC per person.
Written as legacy-style 'c.324delC'; no transcript or protein change is stated in the paper.
Sex is not reported for any of the four.
notes_for_panel: Evidence is thin: one sibship of four adults known only through a literature-review table, with genotype given as a single variant and no zygosity, segregation or biochemical data in the batch papers.
